reference.title: Ship ox teams with unified team discovery
reference.summary: Built the ox teams CLI command from scratch through heavy iterative UX refinement with the user. First pass was a verbose multi-line dump; the user pushed it through dense single-line, then into an aligned column layout (Name, ID, Slug, Sync) with lipgloss semantic colors and a --json flag. Along the way a real bug surfaced: team names were missing because the command fell back to filesystem-only data; the fix was to query the daemon first, with filesystem as a last resort. That in turn exposed four scattered team-discovery paths (daemon, local config, filesystem, project config), which were consolidated into a single team_discovery.go — fixing a separate bug where ox agent team-ctx sageox failed because slug resolution only saw filesystem data. Landed as PR #308.
key_actions: Created ox teams with aligned columns, semantic colors, and --json output
Iterated UX through verbose, dense, and aligned-columns forms based on user feedback
Switched name resolution from filesystem-only to daemon-first lookup
Added slug and non-production endpoint display
Consolidated 4 team-discovery paths into a single team_discovery.go
Fixed ox agent team-ctx sageox failing due to slug-less filesystem data
